# KodeToCareer - Career-Focused Tech Courses & Placement Platform

> KodeToCareer is an ISO 9001:2015 certified live training institute in India offering career-focused technology courses with guaranteed internship and placement support. Founded in 2021 by Md Arbaaz, KodeToCareer delivers live bootcamps in MERN, Data Science, Python, Data Analytics, Java, and Cloud/DevOps.

## Mission & Summary
- **Mission**: Empower aspiring software engineers, data analysts, and tech professionals across India with industry-aligned live training, hands-on project portfolios, and 100% placement assistance.
- **Certifications & Recognition**: ISO 9001:2015 Certified, NSDC Certified, Startup India Recognized.
- **Location**: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India.
- **Founder & Lead Tech Instructor**: Md Arbaaz.
- **Core Domains Offered**: Full Stack MERN Development, Data Science & Machine Learning, Python Programming & Automation, Data Analytics & BI, Java Full Stack, Cloud Computing & DevOps.

## Placement Statistics
- **Placement Rate**: 95% placement rate
- **Hiring Partners**: 500+ top tech companies, scaleups, and enterprise hiring partners
- **Graduates Placed**: 1200+ graduates successfully placed in tech roles
